result.summary: The page is mostly visually coherent, but an untranslated localization key is prominently exposed. Some horizontal carousel content is also awkwardly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Add or correct the translation for this key and provide a readable fallback such as "Popular near you" if localization fails.

issues.description: Items at the right edge of the category and restaurant carousels are heavily clipped, including a nearly empty partial category pill and truncated restaurant content.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing, viewport padding, and snap positions so the next item is intentionally previewed without appearing accidentally cut off.
